notes.title: Project Malice v3.0 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997500/e797f5e16c11eae907dadd65253b448f58084d9e.png[/img]

What's up malice projectors! It's me, ya boi, back with another update! This is update v3.0, the "last" update for the game!

(even though it has the v3.0 tag it's actually pretty small lol)

So this game has been in Early Access since January, and uhh... yeah. Kinda figured that I should, like, finish it. Y'know? Most of the stuff that I put in this update was stuff that was supposed to be added in a long time ago but wanted to wait until the game felt more "complete" before doing that. But now I'm at that point where I'm sort of done with working on this and want to start moving onto my next project (probably). This is sort of a "soft" full release since I can't really de-list it as Early Access now because of the upcoming Halloween Sale, I'll probably do that early November.

Here's the stuff in the new update:

[b]New playable character! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997500/ba6ed3b0f09459cfb1e484ac6cc4ddd5996ecd8f.png[/img]

OoooOOOOooo! It's the main antagonist!!
(a good chunk of people probably saw this coming a mile away)

They're unlocked by getting all of the endings as the rest of the gang, when playing as them the Malicious won't attack you and none of the main bosses appear, but you'll be attacked by recruits and shops will not be available.

[b]B-Skins for everyone![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997500/0f93ae13e90f2011bccae6a60af0e9cdf414d54c.png[/img]

guys I turned stigma into a furry!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997500/d24b83909b22abe6fad494ea5cae9ca34f0b3cf9.png[/img]

muda muda

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997500/465927849f69e64f2ca89af1f9157f47789cc56a.png[/img]

omg she's scottish now

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997500/de62877e1bc4a527d894c3bc7f3cd40ad96d54a3.png[/img]

jordan with full hair!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997500/600be50b1aa4d88d49c42e5466ff6354c1df8b82.png[/img]

you are malicious, child. but I am beyond malice

each of the B-Skins has unique traits and some unique weapons/specials, they're unlocked by getting endings for the respective characters

[b]Hats & Pets![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997500/0f120b256bbc41b0c8d4548bb8144c4fc7a85a82.png[/img]

guys there's hats now!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997500/48b50090c6d6926cbbb4b3da7b9e64695272e64f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997500/614057bf0de06bbefb0ed354e1e37664207e24c3.png[/img]

and pets!! lil dudes who follow you around!! so cute!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997500/fa229b493c99f5caa76c7dfaeec2d11a3af9c0fd.png[/img]

guys you can wear a frog on your head this is very important

those are the major additions so far, there's some other small stuff as well, plus some bug/crash fixes and stuff

yeah, overall not a super big update, mostly just tying up loose ends

I think I'll write a post-mortem for the game and share my thoughts there once it's actually out in Early Access, I think I'm going to update the demo as well to reflect the new changes and stuff

Thank you guys so much for playing! Remember the game will be on sale for the Steam Scream Fest so tell your friends to wishlist the game! If you run into any problems you know where to find me, enjoy!

notes.title: Project Malice v2.7 Update
notes.content:
Hey there! I'm back at ya with another Project Malice update! This one's probably the biggest one I've done since releasing the game in Early Access last January, got some pretty big fundamental changes + some additions that can change the way you play!

Woah, look at this lady... she sells Overclocks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997500/7ed3f0d8f1099e9f04f7a425035c23475bd1d464.png[/img]

Overclocks are variations of existing weapons that change how they function, you can find her at every safe room after talking to Jordan about plot stuff

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997500/8f2e8a83d9684018a20753f80367b6c7b1731e82.png[/img]

We've also got some sexy androids 😳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997500/b0cc0cb1493fd9de757e4f22f15a43b1c95a2ac2.png[/img]

and some goblins...?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997500/b209790b2dd892073b8b7e86abcbada130ae98b5.png[/img]

after talking to these two you'll unlock the Level Editor, where you can create and share custom levels which can appear in your runs! (you can also do some wacky stuff with the wiring as well)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997500/6f607f84cba56eba112bcea15c1762744bb6dbf4.png[/img]

we've also got.... what's huh??? new skins?!?!?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997500/8231b1e64d8777df755a98ae44c946453ddd7e7e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997500/1f1a28e27fd7f92da73bca50497e7852a1b62169.png[/img]

I've added in B-Skins, for Tony & Kate, which you can unlock by getting Ending 1B (this will probably change in the future)
Their B-Skins are more than cosmetic, as they have special traits and unique weapons! I plan on having at least 1 B-Skin for every playable character in the game 😳

I've also completely revamped the level generation system, so randomly generated rooms are much larger and more diverse

And plenty of more stuff! There's also some bug fixes n QoL improvements as well, got some good feedback from a few folks who tried out the pre-release branch, so hopefully I won't have to do another day one patch for this update 🤞

As always, if you run into any problems feel free to DM me on Discord and I'll try to have them resolved asap, this is a pretty big update so I anticipate there's probably a few lil buggers running around somewhere...

Thanks for playing! The game's almost complete, I can already taste it!

notes.title: Project Malice v2.7 Update Pre-Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997500/66937c0a6c73cd44e9ce93f1e8b824c24322cccd.png[/img]

Hey gamers! It's me again, I'm back with another Project Malice update!! (well, almost)

I've created a new pre-release branch for the game so you can beta test the next update before it comes out! This next update is going to be pretty hefty, so I'm going to be doing this first instead of releasing it outright like previous ones. The game's getting close to being finished (fingers crossed) so hopefully this is good training for any post-full-release updates if I do any.

If you'd like to try out the pre-release, just head on over to Project Malice in your library, right click and head to Properties > Betas > Beta Participation and click on the pre-release branch

Here's a few things I'm looking out for:
[list]
[*] The new level generation system works properly
[*] The level editor works properly & players are able to share levels through the workshop
[*] The new enemy difficulty scaling doesn't make the game impossible to play
[/list]
and of course, just looking out for general bugs/glitches/whatever that probably shouldn't be in the game

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3025407168]I uploaded an Example Level to the workshop[/url] if you'd like a sample of what you can make with the new level editor, it's pretty nifty

Please keep in mind that some stuff may change depending on player feedback, if you' find any bugs or have any feedback you can DM me on Discord (@aplove) and I'll try to respond asap

Thanks for playing! Update will be out on the public build if things go smoothly

Have fun! Thank you for playing!

Notable changes & additions:
[list]
[*] You can grapple enemies now! By dodging into them you can grab them and throw them!
[*] In the Refuge there's a new Build Setup, which basically lets you adjust your stats (such as Health, Damage, Speed, etc.) by subtracting from one category and adding to another. (so if you want to be a tank, you can decrease your speed to increase your health)
[*] I've made some changes to the achievements, I've added some new ones but have also removed some of them (mostly just boring/annoying ones). Because the game isn't considered a "real" game by Steam the game is capped at 100 achievements, so I'm probably going to continue to remove achievements as I add in new ones (some of you guys might have the new ones already since I basically just used the same slots)
[/list]
Hope you guys enjoy! Let me know if you run into any problems. Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Project Malice Steam Release & v2.1 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42997500/8542c73b90e06df161d2a55830638330ecd29f85.png[/img]

Hello my beautiful, amazing, wonderful friends

Project Malice is out on Steam! (in Early Access)​

I've been looking at that big green button for almost a month now. It was speaking to me. "Press me! Release the game on Steam RIGHT NOW," it said. It taunted me. I couldn't take it anymore. So, I decided to punch it in its stupid little face to make it shut up. Coincidentally, the game is now available for purchase and download on Steam. I don't know if that was supposed to happen, so I've decided to roll with it.

For those who have played the version on itch, I've also released a notably-sized content update for the game which adds a bunch of new fun things, which include:
[list]
[*] A new area & boss!
[*] New enemies & NPCs!
[*] New weapons!
[*] New dialogue!
[*] New achievements!
[*] Unlockable palettes!
[*] Quality of Life improvements!
[/list]
​And most importantly... I have now added sex to the game 😳

To access the ​18+ content, you can get it through the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2211740/Project_Malice__18_DLC/]Free DLC that's available on Steam​ [/url]

I've enjoyed working on this update, and I'm glad the game is finally out on Steam. Thank you for playing!
